hooks.description: Block dangerous shell commands that could damage the project or hardware

hooks.prompt: Context: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST: Determine if this session involved creating or modifying knowledge reference files (markdown files in skills directories). If NO knowledge reference files were created or modified in this session, respond {"ok": true} immediately — this hook only applies to knowledge authoring sessions. If knowledge files WERE modified, check: 1) New or modified reference files contain substantive content (not stubs). 2) Code examples in reference files compile conceptually (correct Zephyr API usage). 3) No TODO/FIXME markers left in reference content. Respond {"ok": true} if complete, or {"ok": false, "reason": "specific issue"}.
